children: Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (AESI) filed a Form 8K - Other Events - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 25, 2026.

Atlas Energy Solutions ProjectCo, LLC, a Texas limited liability company and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of the Company ("ProjectCo") entered into two purchase commitments for an aggregate of 283 MW of Caterpillar natural gas generation equipment outside of the Global Framework Agreement between ProjectCo and Caterpillar Inc. (the "Incremental Equipment Purchase") for a specific power generation project (the "ProjectCo Project"). The Incremental Equipment Purchase is supported by a cost reimbursement agreement entered into by ProjectCo with a leading frontier AI lab, which is also the intended off taker for the ProjectCo Project.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1984060/000119312526401582/aesi-20260925.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1984060/000119312526401582/0001193125-26-401582-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
